validation_rules.name: R1 Attribute Completeness
validation_rules.description: Model elements without identity or compliance-critical properties are not yet model elements.

checks.name: R1a Name present
checks.description: Element must carry a non-empty Name (direct attribute).

checks.name: R1b FireRating present
checks.description: Non-empty FireRating found in ANY attached property set (standard or vendor).

validation_rules.name: R2 Exit Door Width
validation_rules.description: Doors that must allow passage must actually be wide enough (nominal width as a documented proxy for clear width).

condition.threshold_basis: GB50016 (疏散门净宽 >= 0.9 m) / IBC 813 mm
